from fastmcp import Server

server = Server("simple-tool-server")

@server.tool()
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Add two numbers together."""
    return a + b

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server.run(
        host="127.0.0.1",
        port=8000,
        transport="http"
    )
